summary: Israeli forces assassinated Hamas internal security chief Naim Abu Nahal in Gaza City while conducting airstrikes over Lebanon's Beqaa Valley. Iran conducted multiple missile test launches from Khoy and Marivan and heavy UAV activity at Omidiyeh 5th Fighter Base. Saudi Arabia reported a second Houthi attack on a Riyadh financial district tower within a week.

sections.threat_assessment: The simultaneous Israeli strike on Hamas's internal security chief in Gaza and Iranian missile/UAV demonstrations across multiple provinces indicate a coordinated escalation posture. IRGC evacuation from Beirut's Dahiyeh suggests Tehran anticipates expanded Israeli operations in Lebanon, while Houthi attacks on Riyadh demonstrate persistent regional proxy threats. The Israeli security cabinet meeting Thursday will likely determine near-term operational tempo against Iranian assets in Syria and Lebanon.
sections.regional_response: Bahrain's designation of a PMF commander reflects Gulf concerns over Iranian-backed militia influence. Saudi confirmation of repeated Houthi strikes on Riyadh underscores the failure of current deterrence. Lebanese municipalities are warning civilians away from drone impact sites, indicating a pattern of targeted harassment. US diplomatic reassurances on aid continuity aim to stabilize Israeli planning amid domestic political turbulence.
sections.intelligence_notes: The clustering of Iranian missile tests in West Azerbaijan, Kurdistan, and Khuzestan within hours suggests a deliberate signaling campaign rather than routine training. UAV launches from Omidiyeh 5th Fighter Base may indicate operational deployment of Shahed-type drones. The C-17 overflight of Palestine and C-130 departure from Mehrabad point to heightened US and Iranian air mobility. Monitoring of IRGC evacuation routes from Dahiyeh to Beqaa will reveal force preservation priorities.
